## What changed?

Describe the change and why it belongs in this repository. If it concerns a
submitted project, reference the submission issue (for example, `#123`).

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change follows the contribution guidelines and contains no personal information or secrets.
- [ ] I ran the offline tests and `python scripts/catalog.py check`.
- [ ] For new or changed listings: the project maintainers consent to the listing, and a community maintainer has checked eligibility, README quality, and license.
- [ ] For registry changes: I ran `python scripts/catalog.py refresh` and included all three generated files (`registry/metadata.json`, `PROJECTS.md`, and `docs/index.html`).
- [ ] Any new gallery cover is reviewed, locally stored, and credited without personal or private information.
- [ ] I reviewed the full diff, including generated links and text.

Checks and submitted confirmations are not approval. A human maintainer must
review and approve the pull request before it is merged.
